_comment: Single source for web security headers (DESIGN-02). Applied by vite dev/preview (vite.config.ts); the CloudFront response-headers policy (OPS/infra) and nginx.conf must carry the same values. style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' because Radix (scroll lock, popper) injects style elements; scripts stay 'self' only with no inline script in index.html.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
